text:
Iris (CSM): Heads-up: NovaEdge flagged in today's renewal scan. Active integrations fell ~52% in the past 8 days and their main technical contact moved roles. Need a rapid triage.
Tom (AM): Oof. Any indication it's a product issue vs org change / procurement?
Iris (CSM): Early signals: one spike in errors 2 weeks ago, then a config change in their release notes mentioning "SDK upgrade to v3.4.1". Also procurement filed a vendor evaluation note on Monday.
alert-bot: Alert: customer_id=novaedge usage dropped below rolling baseline (8d) — automated tag: "renewal-risk".
Liu (SE): Can we get route breakdown? If embeddings vs transform routes differ we'll tailor outreach.
Iris (CSM): Route snapshot from analytics (short): /v1/transform down 67%, /v1/embeds down 15%. Most churn from transform pipeline.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Proposal: offer 10-day dedicated pilot nodes (free) + hands-on migration support for new contact. Works well when SDK/flag churn is root cause.
Tom (AM): Agree. Also suggest a concurrent QBR with procurement + infra + dev to align success criteria.
Liu (SE): Quick telemetry check: I can run a KV/cache and key-rotation audit. Ping me the query and I'll run in 20m.
Iris (CSM): SQL I ran:
```sql
SELECT route, date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) FROM requests
WHERE customer_id='novaedge' AND ts >= now() - interval '10 days'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```
Iris (CSM): Key days: 2026-04-01: 980 calls, 2026-04-05: 420, 2026-04-08: 310.
Liu (SE): Running check now. Also please ask customer if they rolled any API keys to read-only or rotated secrets. That would explain drop without errors.
Iris (CSM): Good call. I'll DM their new contact (M. Perez) and copy procurement.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Draft outreach we can send:
"Hi M. Perez — we noticed transform calls reduced significantly after your SDK upgrade. Quick asks: did you rotate keys or flip a feature flag? We'd like to provision a short dedicated pilot (no cost) and run a 1:1 session to verify integration patterns and batching settings. Can you share a sample request id from /v1/transform?"
Tom (AM): I'll add a renewal-play tag in CRM: "sdk-upgrade-impact" and mark as "at-risk: procurement-eval".
Liu (SE): Results from telemetry: no server-side model fallbacks or increased latency. However KV cache hit rate fell from 71% -> 18% across the window and we saw a burst of small requests (many with empty context). That looks like client-side serialization bug.
Iris (CSM): that aligns w/ SDK bump theory. I'll call M. Perez and offer the pilot + repair session.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a 20-min workshop focused on transform batching, context preservation, and SDK best practices (ETA 24h).
Tom (AM): If procurement presses price vs competitor, offer a 2-week pilot extension + dedicated latency SLO during the pilot. Ask procurement for 3 acceptance criteria for the POC.
Iris (CSM): Actions: 1) Liu full log audit + share sample offending request IDs (ETA 1h) 2) Noah prepare workshop deck (24h) 3) Tom update CRM & schedule QBR (48h) 4) Iris outreach + call with new contact (ASAP).
Liu (SE): quick note: I found 1 request pattern where client sent empty "user_id" and defaulted batching to single-token mode. I'll attach an example in the follow-up.
Iris (CSM): Great — that explains sudden seat quiet + cost spike for them. I'll include the log snippet in the outreach and lead the call.
Tom (AM): tagging renewal playbook and adding "offer: dedicated-pilot-nodes".
Iris (CSM): Thanks team. Will update thread after the customer call. :thumbsup:
